finding: Translated coverage requires distinguishing the peptide frame, the original nucleotide read, and the displayed qcovhsp value
correction_to_earlier_characterization: The0/30/35/40/80/99cases did not distinguish frame coverage from whole-read coverage. The100percent boundary does. Do not describe the filter as a whole-nucleotide-read coverage filter for tblastx.
display_observation: Some multi-HSP tblastx rows display amino-acid length divided by nucleotide query length as qcovhsp, while single-HSP rows can display the nucleotide span percentage. Preserve raw values and do not use them to infer biological span.
analysis_policy: Keep the original searches unchanged. Record coordinate-derived nucleotide coverage and translated frame coverage explicitly. Each method retains its original30percent query-coverage search argument; near-best taxonomy is unchanged.
query_only_translation_policy: tblastn takes one full peptide frame per query; its30percent coverage threshold is therefore expressed on the peptide-frame length. Pool frames only after coordinate mapping and retain every original read in the denominator.
